entity_progress: prev copied each own tick; onLandProgress ±1 toward0/5 based on !waterOrBubble&&onGround; flyProgress ±1 toward0/5 based on synced GLIDING.
model_weights: partialTick=ageInTicks-tickCount; interpolate bothprogress; swimProgress=max(0,5-flyProgress)*.2. Fins unfold on flyProgress and body rolls-90deg on landProgress. Both can coexist during transition.
gait: chainSwing [body,tail,tail_fin] phase offsets-2.5 idle,-2swim,-1glide; swim amplitude .45*limbSwingAmount*swimProgress vs glide .15*limbSwingAmount*flyProgress*.2. Four fin flap overlays plus idle bob remain.
pitch: Entity tick maps vertical velocity to target pitch, flips sign when gliding, rotlerp max9deg; model then applies headPitch to body. No independent head bone.
glide: TryFindWater priority1, Glide2, Panic3, random swim4. Glide canContinue tests cached surface/glide and !onGround||water, not GLIDING. start empty; stop clears points/cooldown150..224/GLIDINGfalse but not navigation/delta.
literal_caveats: GlideGoal.tick movementZ adds target.y rather than target.z; face from two surface points has zeroY normally. Source literal, not native trajectory verified.

In final else, alreadygliding+water callsstop then unconditionally writes velocity/rotation andsetGlidingtrue. A directstop during tick does not itself deactivate WrappedGoal; prior Goal lifecycle reused.
If tick calls stop, cachedpoints null; canContinue normally removes next scheduler evaluation, but exact tick scheduling not reexecuted.
No dedicated death clip, ground side-flop is living out-of-water behavior. No death-ground-contact reference credit.
